title: Celebrity Interviews with Joey Mitchell
author: Joey Mitchell
description: With over 51 years as a radio broadcaster, Joey has accumulated an incredible amount of on-air interviews over his career with various celebrities and notable figures. Each week Joey will be adding a podcast with celebrity interviews like Oprah Winfrey, Astronaut Charlie Duke, ABC'sPeter Jennings, Titanic's Robert Ballard, Johnny Cash and many more. Joey will take you behind the scenes with behind the scenes stories from both before and after each interview.. For our Patreon.com supporters, we will be creating additional content and releasing episodes early as a thank you.
